text: Host effort deviation for this whole run: every stage is dispatched as a fresh Claude Code harness subagent, which inherits the driver session's reasoning effort, xhigh. Stages whose packets declare EFFORT high (all author stages) therefore run one level above the declared effort; xhigh review stages run exactly at their declared level. A pinned-effort subagent definition could not be loaded without restarting the host session, and headless CLI workers at an explicit effort were refused by the host's permission policy. No stage runs below its declared effort.
